name: Sold Out
summary: A vending machine 404 page: slot B4 is sold out, so a keypad or search drops another page into the tray
about: A full not-found page in a tiled office corridor with a glossy snack machine, a humming glass front and sixteen labelled spirals, each one a page of the site. Type a word or a code and the coil turns, the packet drops and bounces in the tray, and a printed receipt hands you the link.
how: The sign and the strip light flicker on while the packets pop into their spirals
Type in What are you after? and press Drop it, or tap a code on the keypad and press OK
Press any packet behind the glass to vend it; B4 is your page and swings its Sold out tag
Take it from the tray or open the link on the printed receipt
Insert a coin, press Coin return, or nudge the machine three times for a lucky drop
It plays a short demo by itself until you click or type
